# Check In Problems

Let $Y$ be a continuous random variable with the probability density function

$$f(y)=\frac{3}{2}\sqrt{y}, \qquad 0 \le y \le 1.$$

Use R to generate 10,000 observations of the random variable $Y$.

**Solution:**

$$
F(y)=
\begin{cases}
  0, & y<0,\\[4pt]
  y\sqrt{y}=y^{3/2}, & 0\le y\le 1,\\[4pt]
  1, & y>1.
\end{cases}
$$

```{r}
n <- 10000
p <- runif(n, 0, 1)
samples <- p^(2/3)
```

Let $Y$ be a continuous random variable with the following probability density function

$$
f(y)=\frac{1}{4}y^3, \qquad 0 \le y \le 2.
$$

Use R to generate 10,000 observations of the random variable $Y$.

**Solution:** The cumulative distribution function is

$$
F(y)=
\begin{cases}
  0, & y<0,\\[4pt]
  \dfrac{y^4}{16}, & 0\le y\le 2,\\[6pt]
  1, & y>2.
\end{cases}
$$

```{r}
n <- 10000
p <- runif(n, 0, 1)
samples <- 2*p^(1/4)
```
